rows.grounds: Gloss 'visarga-power-of-universe'; compound analysis: visarga + śakti + viśvasya (dvandva/tatpuruṣa structure); membership inferred from surface form (AMBIGUOUS: exact compound type not determinable from token alone).
Gloss 'cause'; form kāraṇaṃ shows neuter nominative/accusative singular ending -am.
Gloss 'and'; ca is an indeclinable conjunction with no case/number/gender inflection.
Gloss 'ascertained'; past passive participle of √rūp with nis- (nir-√rūp), feminine nominative singular ending -ā agreeing with a feminine subject (AMBIGUOUS: agent not present in token).

Gloss 'in-aitareya-named-vedanta'; bahuvrīhi/tatpuruṣa compound (aitareya + ākhya + vedānta); locative context inferred from translation 'in-...' but surface form is the compounded stem (AMBIGUOUS: case of the compound not overtly marked by a separate ending visible here).
Gloss 'by-supreme-lord'; parameśena is masculine instrumental singular of parameśa, ending -ena.
Gloss 'in-detail'; vistarāt is masculine ablative singular of vistara, ending -āt with ablative meaning 'from/in detail' contextually.
